<style>
#config-filter {
  width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: .45em .6em; margin-bottom: .8em;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--background, #fff); color: currentColor; font: inherit;
}
.config-no-match { display: block; font-style: italic; opacity: .8; margin-top: .5em; }
/* mermaid diagrams: the renderer emits a bare <pre class="mermaid"> (roles are
   dropped by visitMermaid), so center diagrams and let them take the full
   available width via a global rule on the pre and its svg. */
pre.mermaid {
  background: transparent;
  text-align: center;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: .75rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
pre.mermaid svg {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var section = document.querySelector('#_global_configuration .sectionbody');
  if (!section || document.getElementById('config-filter')) { return; }
  var input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'search';
  input.id = 'config-filter';
  input.placeholder = 'Type to filter the options below by key, for example provider, mcp or contextWindow.';
  input.autocomplete = 'off';
  section.insertBefore(input, section.firstChild);
  var polish = function (s) { return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9.]+/g, ''); };
  var apply = function () {
    var q = polish(input.value);
    document.querySelectorAll('.config-list dl').forEach(function (dl) {
      var visible = 0;
      var noMatch = dl.querySelector('.config-no-match');
      dl.querySelectorAll('dt.hdlist1').forEach(function (dt) {
        var dd = dt.nextElementSibling;
        var show = !q || polish(dt.textContent).indexOf(q) !== -1;
        dt.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        if (dd && dd.tagName === 'DD') { dd.style.display = show ? '' : 'none'; }
        if (show) { visible++; }
      });
      if (visible === 0) {
        if (!noMatch) {
          noMatch = document.createElement('p');
          noMatch.className = 'config-no-match';
          noMatch.textContent = 'No option matches the filter.';
          dl.appendChild(noMatch);
        }
        noMatch.style.display = '';
      } else if (noMatch) {
        noMatch.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });
  };
  input.addEventListener('input', apply);
})();
</script>
<script>
// Mermaid diagrams ([mermaid] blocks render to <pre class="mermaid">). The
// asciidoc renderer only injects its mermaid CDN auto-run script when it emits
// a full document; the minisite renders body-only (noheader=true ->
// contentOnly=true), so beforeBodyEnd() is skipped and we must load and run
// mermaid ourselves here.
(function () {
  if (!document.querySelector('pre.mermaid')) { return; } // no diagram on this page
  function runMermaid() {
    if (!window.mermaid) { return; }
    try {
      var theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'default';
      mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: theme, securityLevel: 'loose' });
      var blocks = document.querySelectorAll('pre.mermaid');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(blocks, function (el) { el.removeAttribute('data-processed'); });
      mermaid.run({ nodes: Array.prototype.slice.call(blocks) }).catch(function (e) { console.warn('mermaid render error', e); });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('mermaid init error', e); }
  }
  function loadMermaid() {
    if (window.mermaid) { runMermaid(); return; }
    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.min.js';
    s.onload = runMermaid;
    s.onerror = function () { console.warn('could not load mermaid'); };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  loadMermaid();
  var toggle = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  if (toggle) { toggle.addEventListener('click', function () { setTimeout(runMermaid, 0); }); }
})();
</script>
